verdict.rationale: First-party docs clearly document non-destructive boolean operations (Union, Subtract, Intersect, Difference) and shape styling, and position the Mac app as the place to build interfaces. Alignment appears only as an AI feature that aligns layers automatically, and one community comment calls Sketch's vector editing buggier than Figma's, which counts as comparative criticism rather than a concrete failure. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of pen tool and bezier/path point editing, documentation of manual precise alignment/snapping/distribution tools, independent hands-on corroboration of vector tool quality.
